author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
description: Tactical Grimoire of martial maneuvers, elemental spells, support arts, and tandem relic strikes

skills.name: Repulsive Blow
skills.description: Delivers a heavy shield bash that strikes the target and pushes them back 2 cells on the tactical grid.

skills.name: Flash Jump
skills.description: Leaps to an unoccupied tile within range, invoking a lightning shockwave that damages surrounding foes.

skills.name: Rush
skills.description: Charges directly toward an enemy along a linear path, closing distance and initiating vanguard engagement.

skills.name: Heavy Hit
skills.description: Strikes the target with crushing kinetic force, inflicting Heavy Strike and stripping 3 grid movement points.

skills.name: Provoke
skills.description: Draws the aggressive attention of all nearby enemies upon the vanguard. Grants an immediate follow-up action.

skills.name: Lux Barrio
skills.description: Projects a geometric radiant barrier of pure light. Reduces incoming damage by 25% for 2 to 5 turns, staggers attackers for 25 damage, restores 20 Shield power, and nudges moral sway +3.

skills.name: Fire
skills.description: Channels ambient thermal energy, launching a searing bolt of fire at a single target across medium range.

skills.name: Sparkle
skills.description: Unleashes crackling electrical bolts that strike the target and arc into an area of effect.

skills.name: Volcano Ground
skills.description: Erupts magma beneath the ground, laying multiple burning hazard tiles that damage units crossing them.

skills.name: Ice Wall
skills.description: Constructs a crystalline barrier of solid ice (HP 20) across 3 tiles, blocking enemy line of sight and passage.

skills.name: Cuttatio Tenebris
skills.description: A sweeping crescent slash infused with dark mist. Slices the primary target and deals 20% splash damage to surrounding foes. Consumes 8 to 12 edge points.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: Weaves restorative light, recovering substantial health for an injured ally within range.

skills.name: Light Steps
skills.description: Lightens the burden of armor and footfalls, granting +1 movement point across the grid for 3 turns.

skills.name: Extra Turn
skills.description: Manipulates temporal flow in the tactical queue, granting an allied combatant an immediate extra turn.

skills.name: Duo-Loca Bashin n Slash
skills.description: The signature tandem art uniting the Shield of Lux and Sword of Tenebris. Channels into the foe's weakest defensive attribute (DEF vs MDF), restores +15 Shield and +15 Edge, and harmonizes moral sway toward 0.
